greet: Hello! This conversation is recorded. How can I help you?
greetNoRecord: Hello! How can I help you?
askWho: Please tell me your name and what you came about.
askService: Which company or service are you from?
askCode: Please say the code from your message.
wrongCode: That code does not work. Please try again.
codesLocked: I cannot take a code right now. I will tell the owners you came.
deliver: The owners asked me to tell you: {message}
openFailed: I could not open. I will tell the owners you came.
cannotOpen: I cannot open the door. I will tell the owners you came.
askingOwner: One moment, I am asking the owners.
stillWaiting: The owners have not answered yet, please wait a little.
ownerNoAnswer: The owners cannot answer right now. I will pass on your words.
ownersCannotCome: The owners cannot come to the door right now. What should I tell them?
willPass: Thank you, I will tell the owners.
goodbye: Thank you! Have a nice day!
notHeard: Sorry, I did not catch that. Could you say it again?
areYouThere: Can you hear me? Please tell me your name.
voicemail: Please leave a message after the tone.
voicemailDone: Thank you, your message is recorded.
emergency: Thank you, I am telling the owners right now. If someone is in danger, call 112.
threat: This conversation is recorded and passed to the owners.
probing: I cannot tell you that. What should I pass on to the owners?
manipulation: I cannot open the door. Shall I tell the owners you came?
sales: Thank you, we are not interested. Have a nice day!
blocked: The owners cannot come to the door.
tooLong: Thank you, I will pass everything on. Goodbye!
